Load libraries
```{r}
library(CellTFusion)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
source("src/utils.R")
set.seed(123)
```

Load data
```{r}
counts = read.delim("~/Documents/LungPredict_late_stage/Data/Captier/TIPIT_RNA_TPM_134.txt")
clinical = read.delim("~/Documents/LungPredict_late_stage/Data/Captier/TIPIT_reponse_134.txt")
```

Processed data
```{r}
counts = counts %>%
  dplyr::select(-GeneID) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = T) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("gene_name")

clinical = clinical %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Batch = as.numeric(counts[1,])) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("patient_ID")
  
counts = counts[-1,rownames(clinical)]
```

Add treatment
```{r}
treatment = read.csv("~/Documents/LungPredict_late_stage/Data/Captier/clinical_targets.csv", row.names = 1) 
treatment = treatment[rownames(treatment)%in%rownames(clinical),]
all.equal(rownames(treatment), rownames(clinical))
clinical = clinical %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Treatment = treatment$chemotherapy) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment == 0)
counts = counts[,colnames(counts)%in%rownames(clinical)]
```

Log normalized
```{r}
counts.norm.log = log(counts + 1)
```

Gene sets
```{r}
genesets = readRDS("../output/group_marker_genesets.rds")
tfs = scale(compute.TFs.activity(counts.norm.log))
sig_scores = compute.pathway.activity(t(tfs), gene_sets = genesets)[[2]]
patient_group <- apply(sig_scores, 1, function(x) names(which.max(x)))
clinical$group = patient_group
```

Compute survival analysis
```{r}
res_clusters = compute.survival.analysis(clinical, "months")
```

#####################################

Only chemotherapy treated in LP
```{r}
counts_LP_chemo = read.csv("~/Documents/LungPredict_late_stage/Data/Gobbini/Raw_files/counts_raw.csv", row.names = 1)
clinical_LP_chemo = read.csv("~/Documents/LungPredict_late_stage/Data/Gobbini/Raw_files/clinical_data_clean.csv") %>%
  dplyr::filter(N_Raw_matrice_Bulk %in% colnames(counts_LP_chemo)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("N_Raw_matrice_Bulk") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment == "CT") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(PFS) & !is.na(PFS_event))

counts_LP_chemo = counts_LP_chemo[,rownames(clinical_LP_chemo)] #Order samples on counts based on clinical data
```

Log normalized
```{r}
counts_LP_chemo.norm.log = log(counts_LP_chemo + 1)
```

Gene sets
```{r}
genesets = readRDS("group_marker_genesets.rds")
tfs = scale(compute.TFs.activity(counts_LP_chemo.norm.log))
sig_scores = compute.pathway.activity(t(tfs), gene_sets = genesets)[[2]]
patient_group <- apply(sig_scores, 1, function(x) names(which.max(x)))
clinical_LP_chemo$group = patient_group
```

Survival analysis
```{r}
res_clusters = compute.survival.by.groups(clinical_LP_chemo, "months")
```
